name: Image Panel Nav
description: Full-screen navigation made of image panels that reveal a short description on hover. Clicking a panel wipes open a full-screen detail view with image, title and text.
contents: Four side-by-side image panels (stacked rows on mobile) with tag, arrow icon, title and short description
Full-screen detail overlay per item with image, title, paragraphs and close button
behavior: Image desaturates and zooms slightly, description expands on hover
Click opens a detail panel with a clip-path wipe and delayed text fade-in
Escape key or close button closes the detail panel
Mobile stacks panels in rows and the detail view stacks image above text
editableByProps: Items, tags, titles, descriptions, images and detail paragraphs
Button labels, fonts, animation speed and colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the number of columns on desktop
needsCodeEdit.where: md:grid-cols-4 class on the nav element

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the arrow or close icons

fixed: Fills the viewport height as a full-screen section
Loads Hanken Grotesk and Newsreader from Google Fonts through link tags
Layout assumes four items on desktop, other counts change panel widths on mobile rows
